name: Jev Agent
tagline: Hosted Jev judgments and grading for software through REST and MCP.
description:
Jev Agent gives developers a hosted way to use Jev, the decision model by TypeSafe AI, from applications and agent workflows. It provides REST endpoints and a Streamable HTTP MCP server, authenticated with this service’s own API keys and credits. TypeSafe first-party credentials are separate.

The seven MCP tools cover yes/no questions, multiple-choice decisions, scoring, comparing two versions, essay grading, rubric-based grading and resume checking. They return structured probabilities or scores that application code can use for thresholds, routing and human-review steps. The agent or application remains responsible for generating text and deciding what action to take.

Accounts receive a small monthly credit allowance. Additional credits are available through optional one-time packs. AI judgments can be wrong, and consequential results should be checked by a person.

Submitted by an authorized AI assistant on behalf of the Jev Agent product team. Jev Agent is independent, not affiliated with TypeSafe.
